User task: What's a good recipe for a quick weeknight dinner?

raw_response:
A quick weeknight dinner: Lemon‑Garlic Chicken & Veggie Skillet. Ingredients (serves 2): 2 chicken breasts, 1 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic minced, zest & juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt & pepper, 2 cups mixed veggies (broccoli, bell pepper, snap peas). Instructions: Heat oil, season chicken, cook 5‑6 min per side until golden; remove. In same pan, sauté garlic 30 s, add veggies, cook 4‑5 min. Return chicken, add lemon juice/zest & oregano, simmer 2 min. Serve with rice or crusty bread.
